title: Statistical claim example — pre-registered drug-effect threshold (template)
claimText: Drug X reduces systolic blood pressure by >= 5 mmHg vs placebo (one-sample t-test on paired deltas; H0: mean_effect <= 0; alpha = 0.05, one-sided)

falsificationSpec.prediction: the mean systolic-BP reduction with Drug X exceeds 5 mmHg vs placebo

honestBoundary: Template claim — not a real clinical verdict. A live CONFIRMED/REFUTED here requires injecting a real StatisticalResult (one-sample t-test) through the agent loop (`far ask`), which recomputes the statistic deterministically (no hand-filled p-values, per the RR-1 red line). This file illustrates the claim + statistical-plan structure that the deterministic kernel consumes; it is not itself a sealed verdict.
workflow: far init statdemo --out ./statdemo  →  edit fec.template.json  →  far fec compile --claim ./statdemo/fec.template.json --out ./statdemo/compiled.json  →  far ask "<question based on this claim>" --profile offline_replay
